sloka: यानि कानिचित् अपि अत्र सत्त्वानि निवसन्ति उत ।सर्वाणि शरणम् यामि मृग पक्षि गणान् अपि ॥३-४९-३३॥
transliteration: yāni kānicit api atra sattvāni nivasanti uta ।sarvāṇi śaraṇam yāmi mṛga pakṣi gaṇān api ॥3-49-33॥

translations.english: I offer my salutations to different deities residing in this forest abounding in trees of many kinds. Tell my husband about me that I am being whisked away.
